description: `bump` for dependencies, devDependencies, optionalDependencies, resolutions and pnpm catalog entries (`pnpm.catalog.<name>`, any catalog name), `widen` for engines and peerDependencies, `in-range-only` for overrides, in package.json and in pnpm-workspace.yaml (`pnpm-workspace.overrides`). In `default.json` this comes after `base`, so it overrides the `:pinDevDependencies` that `config:best-practices` brings: devDependencies are bumped, not pinned.
